audience: merchants who sell on Bumpa and manage orders, shipping and sales reports

useCases.title: Find paid orders that are not shipped
useCases.text: List orders filtered by payment and shipping status, for example paid orders that are not shipped yet.

useCases.title: Review sales and product analytics
useCases.text: Read sales or product analytics for a date range, by type. Read summary cards for orders and customers.

useCases.title: Read abandoned-order metrics
useCases.text: Read the abandoned-order metrics of the store, for orders.

useCases.title: Update the shipping status of an order
useCases.text: Find the order, then set its shipping status to shipped, delivered or another status. The new status overwrites the current one.

useCases.title: Retry a shipping booking or export orders
useCases.text: Queue a new automated shipping booking for a paid order. Or queue a CSV export that Bumpa emails to the store owner.
